title: FlightReacts Laugh
blurb: A cackle that escalates from a controlled wheeze into total system failure, and became its own form of currency online. What makes it so reusable is the arc — the laugh has a beginning, a middle and a collapse, so it can be timed against footage in a way that a single burst never could. The internet deploys it wherever composure is visibly being lost in real time. Use it for reactions that start out dignified and end in tears. One of streaming culture's genuinely contagious sounds.
